description: This HTML file implements the front-end interface for a Database Viewer application, including UI layout, styling, and client-side JavaScript logic to fetch and display database information and table data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the database list in the UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the database list with a loading spinner, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table, rendering it in a scrollable, styled table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying the data table with headers and rows, including conditional display hints.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell for a given data value, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandable functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content or truncated preview.
